theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have h₁ : relation d e := h.1
  have h₂ : relation e f := h.2
  have h₃ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) := (hrelation d e).mp h₁ |>.2
  have h₄ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) := (hrelation e f).mp h₂ |>.2
  
  have h₅ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by
    intro i
    have h₆ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) := h₃ i
    have h₇ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      calc
        digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then e j else d j) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by simp only [hdigits_to_num]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j + if j = i then (e j - d j) else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          by_cases h : j = i
          · simp [h]
            ring
          · simp [h]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) + (if j = i then (e j - d j) else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          ring
        _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, d j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ)) + ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then (e j - d j) else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          simp only [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_mul, zero_mul]
          <;> simp
          <;> ring
    rw [h₇] at h₆
    have h₈ : (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by ring
    rw [h₈]
    exact h₆
  
  have h₆ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by
    intro i
    have h₇ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) := h₄ i
    have h₈ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      calc
        digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then f j else e j) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by simp only [hdigits_to_num]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j + if j = i then (f j - e j) else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          by_cases h : j = i
          · simp [h]
            ring
          · simp [h]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) + (if j = i then (f j - e j) else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          ring
        _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, e j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ)) + ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then (f j - e j) else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          simp only [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_mul, zero_mul]
          <;> simp
          <;> ring
    rw [h₈] at h₇
    have h₉ : (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by ring
    rw [h₉]
    exact h₇
  
  have h₇ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have h₈ : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d + ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      calc
        digits_to_num e = ∑ i : Fin 9, e i * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by simp only [hdigits_to_num]
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 9, (d i + (e i - d i)) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 9, (d i * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
        _ = (∑ i : Fin 9, d i * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num d + ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    have h₉ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro i _
      exact h₅ i
    have h₁₀ : ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      calc
        ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + ∑ i : Fin 9, digits_to_num d := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [h₁₀] at h₉
      exact h₉
    have h₁₂ : digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d = 2 * digits_to_num d + ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      rw [h₈]
      ring
    have h₁₃ : 7 ∣ (∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + 2 * digits_to_num d := by
      have h₁₄ : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := by use digits_to_num d
      have h₁₅ : (∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + 2 * digits_to_num d = ((∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + 9 * digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by ring
      rw [h₁₅]
      exact dvd_sub h₁₁ h₁₄
    rw [h₁₂]
    exact h₁₃
  
  have h₈ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro i
    have h₉ : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d := by
      have h₁₀ : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := h₆ i
      have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) := dvd_sub h₁₀ h₇
      have h₁₂ : ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) = (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d := by ring
      rw [h₁₂] at h₁₁
      exact h₁₁
    have h₁₀ : 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := h₅ i
    have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d) + ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) := dvd_add h₉ h₁₀
    have h₁₂ : ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d) + ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) = (f i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by ring
    rw [h₁₂] at h₁₁
    exact h₁₁
  
  intro i
  have h₉ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := h₈ i
  have h₁₀ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) := by
    have h₁₁ : (7 : ℕ).Prime := by decide
    have h₁₂ : ¬(7 : ℤ) ∣ 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      intro h
      have h₁₃ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by norm_cast at h ⊢
      have h₁₄ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow h₁₁ h₁₃
      norm_num at h₁₄
    have h₁₃ : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (f i - d i) ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp h₉
    cases h₁₃ with
    | inl h₁₃ => exact h₁₃
    | inr h₁₃ => exfalso; exact h₁₂ h₁₃
  have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ -(f i - d i) := dvd_neg.mpr h₁₀
  have h₁₂ : -(f i - d i) = d i - f i := by ring
  rw [h₁₂] at h₁₁
  exact h₁₁
